seo.title: Multiply Labs | Robotic Biomanufacturing Product Story
seo.description: A tailored product film and landing page for Multiply Labs, built around its robotic cluster and the questions commercial, process and quality teams need answered.

hero.title: Keep the instruments
hero.body: Multiply Labs builds modular robotic clusters to automate work around the GMP instruments manufacturers already use. See how the system, software and process story come together for commercial, engineering and quality teams.

hero.note: Built around your existing GMP instruments.

steps.title: Start with familiar equipment.

steps.copy: Four robotic arms coordinate tasks such as liquid handling, dispensing and transfers inside the cluster. Keep the animation at platform level; confirm any customer-specific sequence with the technical team.

steps.title: Close with the information trail.

steps.title: Revise, approve and prepare share versions

faqs.question: Can the film and landing page be tailored to our audience?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start with one buyer and one question, then shape the storyboard, voice, visuals and page around that audience. Commercial, process and quality teams can each get a relevant entry point.

faqs.question: Can we review and revise the work?
faqs.answer: Yes. Agree on review points and revision scope up front. The team can review the storyboard and voice direction first, then give consolidated notes on the film and landing page before final approval.

faqs.question: Can DHEE make versions for different channels or languages?
faqs.answer: Yes. The production plan can include 16:9, 9:16 and square cuts, captions and approved language versions. Product terminology and translations should be reviewed by Multiply Labs before sharing.

faqs.question: Does the film show Multiply Labs’ actual robot?
faqs.answer: No. The animation is illustrative, not footage or a verified simulation of Multiply Labs’ equipment or process. Public product photography is used separately to show the actual platform.

faqs.question: Where do the product facts come from?
faqs.answer: The page uses information published by Multiply Labs. Any customer-specific workflow, performance claim or regulatory wording should be confirmed by its product and quality teams before external use.

faqs.question: What would a final company-approved version need?
faqs.answer: A confirmed audience and use case, approved product references, technical review of the script and visuals, and final sign-off from the relevant product, engineering and quality stakeholders.

faqs.question: Does our team need to use a video tool or manage generation credits?
faqs.answer: No. DHEE runs the production workflow, including visual generation, editing, captions and format versions. Your team supplies approved product information, reviews the storyboard and claims, and signs off on the final assets. The revision scope is agreed before production.
